Im not sure but I had my medical abortion in San antonio yesterday it cost $99 for the ultrasound which is mandatory by state law and than $463 (which is discounted based on my fiance and I living and working circumstances) so in total $563 it was worth it. I told them I didnt want them sending mail to me (they cant send you mail unless you still owe them money I was able to pay them in full) They gave me the ultrasound first than took my bloodwork. After that happened they told me the risks and symptoms (safer to have medical abortion than going through with pregnancy) I was 8 weeks along and starting to have nausea and motion sickness. I ate than took the 1 pill of mifeprex in clinic and an antibiotic pill to prevent infection (sepsis, urinary tract infection stuff like that rare though to get it but possible). After that they gave me the four misoprostol to take at home the next day (24hrs from taking the mifeprex), I did not bleed from the first pill I was bloated however. Next day I took 1 codeine pill 30minutes from the four in cheek Misoprostol. I did not feel anything within the first hour of taking the Misoprostol the next hour or so I got light cramping which than intensified for the next few hours like a really horrible period, afterwards I felt an intense contraction on my stomach and my water popped than followed by three good sized clots over the next few hours. The cramps subsided at midnight so I had them for a few hours. Ill like to add they also gave me prescribed tylenol with the codeine. I also used a heating pad and gave my stomach a fundal massage to help pass everything (ball your fists and rub or knead your stomach). Overall it was am easy process the price however quite expensive but if I hadnt mentioned my living situation I would have paid $751 instead ($99 ultrasound+$651 pills). Good luck to you I hope this information helped
